narrative.details:
It isn't often that I get visitors. As a matter of fact, the last time I had a visitor was when I rescued that dear, sweet gnome from the wreckage of the crashed flying machine.

<Meridith gazes into nothingness, lost in a memory.>

Do you know him? Narain? Narain Soothfancy? Oh it would mean so much to me if somebody would deliver a message to him for me. I must tell him how I feel! I know it's love! I just know it!

Could you possibly deliver a message to Narain? I would be forever indebted to you!
narrative.objectives: Take Meridith's Love Letter to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.
narrative.offerRewardText:
What!?

<Narain starts to fidget.>

Well, um... What do you want me to do??? She's a fish! A FISH I tell you! And I'm a gnome. It could never work out.
